title: Website Content Crawler Input
description: Crawl a website and ship clean Markdown, plain text, token estimates, and optional auto chunks for RAG and LLM pipelines. Paste start URLs and run.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: URLs to start the crawl from. Each URL is treated as the entry point for that website.

crawlerType.title: Crawler type
crawlerType.description: Cheerio is the fast default for static pages and docs sites. Use Playwright for sites that render content via JavaScript. Adaptive picks Playwright automatically.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Hard cap on pages crawled per run across all start URLs. Set to 0 for unlimited.

maxDepth.title: Max link depth
maxDepth.description: How many link hops away from the start URL the crawler is allowed to follow. 0 means only the start URLs.

useSitemap.title: Use sitemap
useSitemap.description: Auto discover sitemap.xml, sitemap_index.xml, and robots.txt sitemap entries to seed the crawl. Recommended for large sites.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip URLs disallowed by the site's robots.txt. Turn off for internal scraping work where you have a contract.

includeUrlPatterns.title: Include URL patterns
includeUrlPatterns.description: Glob patterns. Pages must match at least one of these to be crawled. Empty means everything on the same domain. Examples: '**/docs/**', '**/blog/*'.

excludeUrlPatterns.title: Exclude URL patterns
excludeUrlPatterns.description: Glob patterns. Pages matching any of these are skipped. Examples: '**/login/**', '**/api/**', '**/*.zip'.

stayOnDomain.title: Stay on the same domain
stayOnDomain.description: Only follow links on the same registrable domain as the start URL (e.g. apify.com and docs.apify.com both count when on).

stayOnSubdomain.title: Stay on the same subdomain
stayOnSubdomain.description: Only follow links on the exact same hostname as the start URL. Stricter than stayOnDomain.

removeFluff.title: Remove navigation, footers, ads, and modals
removeFluff.description: Strip nav, footer, header, aside, ads, cookie banners, and modals before extracting content. Recommended for AI pipelines.

extractor.title: Main content extractor
extractor.description: Auto picks the best result from Readability, a custom main detector, and a body fallback. Force one if your pipeline needs consistency.

outputFormats.title: Output formats per page
outputFormats.description: Each row carries the formats you select. Markdown is the default for AI pipelines. Plain text is best for token tight LLM contexts. HTML is the cleaned post extraction HTML.

minContentLength.title: Minimum content length
minContentLength.description: Drop pages whose extracted content is shorter than this many characters. Useful for filtering out empty templates and 404 pages.

chunkOutput.title: Auto split into RAG chunks
chunkOutput.description: Push one row per chunk instead of one row per page. Each chunk row carries url, chunkIndex, totalChunks, markdown, tokens, and the page metadata. Built for vector database ingestion.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size in tokens
chunkSize.description: Target token count per chunk when chunkOutput is on. 800 to 1000 works well for most embedding models.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap in tokens
chunkOverlap.description: Tokens of overlap between consecutive chunks. Helps preserve context at chunk boundaries during retrieval.

redactPII.title: Redact PII
redactPII.description: Replace emails, phone numbers, IBANs, and US Social Security numbers with [REDACTED] tokens before output. Useful for GDPR safe RAG indexing.

extractMetadata.title: Extract metadata
extractMetadata.description: Pull JSON LD article and product schemas, OpenGraph tags, author, publish date, and modified date for every page.

extractLinks.title: Extract link graph
extractLinks.description: Each row carries outbound link count split by internal vs external, plus a sample of up to 25 link URLs.

infiniteScroll.title: Trigger infinite scroll
infiniteScroll.description: Scroll the page in stages so lazy loaded content renders before extraction. Playwright crawler only.

waitForSelector.title: Wait for selector
waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector. The crawler waits for this element before extracting content. Playwright crawler only.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Cookies to set before crawling. Use this for pages behind a login. Format: array of {name, value, domain}.

downloadFiles.title: Download linked files
downloadFiles.description: Save linked PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, and CSV files to the key value store. Useful for indexing knowledge bases and research libraries.

downloadFileTypes.title: File extensions to download
downloadFileTypes.description: File extensions the crawler should download when downloadFiles is on.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Pages processed in parallel. Four is a safe default. Drop to two for sites with strict rate limits, raise for fast static sites.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout in seconds
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per page timeout. Long pages or slow sites may need 60 to 90 seconds.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Datacenter is fine for most documentation sites. Use residential for sites with anti scraping protection.
